notes.title: Day 30 · The long fall
notes.text: Your engines are off. The Sun's gravity is doing the flying now, bending your path out to Mars.

notes.title: Day 115 · Earth is a star
notes.text: Messages now take minutes each way. Mission Control can advise you, but it cannot answer in time to save you.

notes.title: Day 210 · Mars ahead
notes.text: Mars is a disc now. Soon you hit its air at about 5 km/s with a heat shield and a parachute. Nothing else.

solarStorm.title: Solar particle event
solarStorm.text: The Sun just released a burst of high-energy protons. They will reach you in minutes. Get to the radiation shelter.
solarStorm._shielding: With the ship's life traits (Role 1, wave 5): doseIgnored behind doseRefGcm2 g/cm² of aluminium-equivalent wall, falling e-fold every attenuationGcm2 g/cm². 8 is an estimate inside the 7–10 g/cm² e-fold range of the blood-forming-organ dose curves in Townsend, Nealy & Wilson, NASA TM-100620 (1988). Result: 150 mSv behind the 5 g/cm² wall, about 78 mSv behind the food and water at hand (10.2 g/cm²), about 44 mSv in the 600 kg water shelter (14.75 g/cm²). Without traits the three fixed doses above are used.
solarStorm.resultShelter: You wait it out in the shelter, behind the water and food stores. Dose from the storm: {dose} mSv.
solarStorm.resultImprovised: There is no shelter on this ship. You huddle behind the water tanks. Dose from the storm: {dose} mSv.
solarStorm.resultIgnored: You stayed where you were. The storm passes straight through the hull. Dose from the storm: {dose} mSv.

malfunction.title: Master alarm: oxygen tank 2
malfunction.text: A bang, then the master alarm. The panel shows:

options.label: Isolate tank 2 and switch to tank 1
options.result: The pressure in tank 1 holds. You've lost tank 2, but you have enough oxygen to get there. Work the problem, one step at a time.

options.label: Vent the cabin to stop a fire
options.result: There was no fire. Cabin pressure drops and the tank keeps leaking. Look at the readings again.

options.label: Restart the flight computer
options.result: The computer comes back. The leak doesn't care. Look at the readings again.

life._about: Crew life in the cruise (life.js; only when the ship has traits.life). A slow cabin leak, up to leakSlowMm2 of hole, is found and sealed after leakPatchDays (Soyuz MS-09, 2018: a 2 mm hole, 3.1 mm², found and sealed within about a day). A bigger hole hisses and the pressure visibly drops: the time to seal falls as a power law to leakAudibleMinutes for a hole of leakAudibleMm2, never under leakFloorMinutes (audible point and floor: estimates). malfunctionBleedShare: each wrong answer in the oxygen-tank emergency lets the damaged line vent this share of the tank on it (estimate).
